items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: one little Mexican guy heard us pounding and went up and broke the lock and let us out.

ctx.x: And we just pounded me and the other guy and we got scared and started crying. And we didn't know it had been side-tracked. And finally one little Mexican guy heard us pounding and went up
and broke the lock and let us out. Because we would have starved easily in there if we hadn't got out of there.
